p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544931/attempts/5b17e8f43661473aad6b536871505fc9/system/state/workspace/programs/task-53014a4c.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marker_colors = {7, 8}
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v in marker_colors for v in row)]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] in marker_colors for r in range(h))]
    # The non-line interior color is the default for nonuniform marker windows.
    interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in row_lines
                for c in range(w) if c not in col_lines]
    default = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(row_lines) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(col_lines) - 1):
            corners = [grid[r][c] for r in row_lines[i:i+2] for c in col_lines[j:j+2]]
            row.append(corners[0] if corners[0] in marker_colors and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners) else default)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
